question: Carl’s favorite food is cheese. He ate a sandwich every day this week for lunch and used 2 slices of cheese on each sandwich. He ate cheese and egg omelets for breakfast 3 days in the week using one more slice per omelet than he did per sandwich. He made a big dish of macaroni and cheese to last him several dinners for the week and used 8 slices of cheese in it. How many slices of cheese did he use?

help_request.instruction: Calculate the total cheese slices used for breakfast, given that Carl used one more slice per omelet than per sandwich.

record.step: Carl used 2 slices of cheese per sandwich for lunch, and since he ate a sandwich every day for 7 days, the total cheese used for lunch is 2 slices/day × 7 days = 14 slices. For breakfast, he made omelets on 3 days, using 3 slices per omelet (1 more than the 2 slices per sandwich). Therefore, the cheese used for breakfast is 3 slices/omelet × 3 days = 9 slices. The macaroni and cheese dish used 8 slices, which is separate from the lunch and breakfast calculations. Adding all the cheese used: 14 slices (lunch) + 9 slices (breakfast) + 8 slices (dinner) = 31 slices of cheese in total.
